title: PhysicsSliders: Learning Physical Controls for Audio Foley Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.18597v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physical properties provide intuitive controls for sounds made by interacting objects. The challenge is to make a generative model respond predictably to these controls, both individually and in combination. We present \method\ (PXS), trained on simulated contact sounds with 15 material, geometry and contact parameters. Two separately trained variants accept direct parameter inputs or numerical captions. PXS controls hardness, size, speed and damping, supports room descriptions and produces spectrally distinct outputs at fixed targets. When controlling damping and size together, specifying thickness improves frequency accuracy and joint target delivery. Measurements from real recordings define effective-damping targets, which simulator inversion maps to generation inputs without real-audio fine-tuning. Across 18 impact classes from five real-audio datasets, PXS-Physical follows these targets with mean grouped Spearman correlation $\rho

translated_title: PhysicsSliders：学习用于音频拟音生成的物理控制
translated_abstract: 物理特性为物体相互作用产生的声音提供了直观的控制方式。其挑战在于让生成模型对这些控制（无论是单独的还是组合的）做出可预测的响应。我们提出了PhysicsSliders（PXS），该模型在包含15个材料、几何和接触参数的模拟接触声音上进行训练。两个分别训练的变体接受直接的参数输入或数值描述。PXS可以控制硬度、大小、速度和阻尼，支持房间描述，并在固定目标下产生频谱上有区分度的输出。在同时控制阻尼和大小时，指定厚度可以提高频率精度和联合目标的达成度。从真实录音中测量的数据定义了有效阻尼目标，通过模拟器反演将这些目标映射到生成输入，无需真实音频微调。在来自五个真实音频数据集的18个撞击声类别中，PXS-Physical以平均分组Spearman相关系数ρ（摘要在此处截断）遵循这些目标。
tldr: 本文提出PhysicsSliders（PXS），一个基于15个物理参数（硬度、大小、速度、阻尼等）可控的音频拟音生成模型，并利用模拟器反演将真实录音测得的有效阻尼目标映射为生成输入，无需真实音频微调即可实现对声音物理特性的精确控制。
en_tdlr: This paper presents PhysicsSliders (PXS), an audio foley generation model controllable via 15 physical parameters (hardness, size, speed, damping, etc.), which uses simulator inversion to map effective-damping targets measured from real recordings to generation inputs, achieving precise physical control of sound generation without real-audio fine-tuning.
